Database.// Provider: Sqlite (default, no server needed) or MySql

Admin.// Keys: Account keys with admin access. Paste the GUID from a user's URL.

Email.// Host: SMTP server for price digests. Empty means no mail is sent at all.
Email.// User: Login to the SMTP account, and the address mail is sent from.
Email.// BaseUrl: Public origin used in emailed links, e.g. https://watchdog.example.com. Needed behind a TLS-terminating proxy, where the request itself arrives as plain http.

Cleanup.// EmptyAccountAge: Accounts with no products, untouched this long, are deleted.
Cleanup.// InactiveAccountAge: Accounts with products, untouched this long, are deleted.
